mentions.name: Pluma (pluma.ink)
mentions.description: A blogging platform for publishing professional-looking articles, featuring a clean WYSIWYG editor, a personal subdomain, and a distraction-free reading experience. It emphasizes simplicity, no ads, no tracking or data harvesting, and reliable long-term publishing.
mentions.audience: people who want to write professional-looking articles with ease
